problem_statement:
Add Text.count

`rich.text.Text` supports `in` but cannot count occurrences. Add a method

    Text.count(sub: str, case_sensitive: bool = True) -> int

that returns the number of non-overlapping occurrences of `sub` in the plain text. `sub` may also be a `Text`, in which case its plain text is used. With `case_sensitive=False` the comparison ignores case. An empty `sub` raises `ValueError`.
